description: This Java class defines the ModifyFeatureStrategy, a strategy class for handling modify feature commands in a Ditto-based IoT framework. It processes commands to modify features of a 'Thing', generates corresponding events, and ensures size constraints are met.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles the ModifyFeature command to modify a feature of a Thing, emitting appropriate events and maintaining size constraints.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Main execution method that applies the modify feature command to the specified Thing, producing a result (modification or creation).

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Extracts the feature specified in the command from the Thing.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Constructs a result indicating that a feature was modified.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Constructs a result indicating that a feature was created.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Provides the entity tag before modification for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Provides the entity tag after modification for concurrency control.
